goal: Keep short follow-up messages anchored to recent conversation history, while treating DC-Agent long-term memory as lower-priority factual reference.

acceptance_criteria.description: When a user sends short feedback or a follow-up such as 不满意, the current intent must be resolved from the recent conversation history before any long-term memory match is considered.
The provider request must remove the dc_agent_memory_context marker block from the current user prompt so the model sees the user's actual short message as the prompt.
DC-Agent long-term memory must be appended only as a lower-priority reference after recent conversation history has established the current project, customer, brand, or task target.
Demoted DC-Agent memory context must be transient provider input and must not be saved back into conversation history as ordinary user content.
The short-term context priority contract must remain wired to a harness test that verifies the contract, core regression entry point, and implementation guardrails.
A Feishu/Lark short-feedback replay must prove that platform-specific message events still use recent conversation history before lower-priority DC-Agent memory.
The dc_router memory retrieval call must pass a query built from recent conversation history plus the current short feedback, instead of querying long-term memory with only the short feedback text.

non_goals: Do not solve this by adding platform-specific WebChat-only behavior.
Do not patch the memory retrieval query by simple string concatenation in dc_memory_context as the sole guardrail.
Do not allow long-term memory to rename or retarget the active brand, customer, project, or task established by recent turns.
